request.subject: PORTRAIT:UNDEAD:FIGHTER

layers.text: Change only the colours: the red helmet crest becomes a ragged near-black crest; the helmet becomes blackened iron with a dull tarnished bronze rim; the red tabard is removed so his bare pale warm ivory collar bones and ribs show, with a ragged near-black charcoal collar with a thin bright violet trim; his eye sockets glow bright violet. Keep the skull, the grin, the sword, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
